summary: Full frontend verification of the YAWYE redesigned marketing site at https://youarewhatyoueat.store (GitHub Pages). All requested features verified: hero copy, official logo, three YouTube (nocookie) embeds with correct video IDs, NOVA 4-level chart, nav anchors, iOS/Android download CTAs with gtag AW-18007960189, £0/£1.99 pricing cards, /subscribe /support /privacy-policy /terms-of-service all return 200, mobile 390x844 renders without horizontal overflow and NOVA cards stack vertically. No console/page errors, Unsplash scan image returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (out of scope for this iteration): Stripe /subscribe checkout POST is known-broken (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not configured on Railway) - page loads but purchase will fail if a user clicks subscribe.
